items.title: 'Fitspo content' worse than modelling industry for woman's eating disorder
items.description: An avalanche of "toxic fitspo content" online was the catalyst for Isabella Charon's eating disorder, but what kickstarted it had been her time within the modelling industry.

items.title: If we scrap the 'beer tax', will pub culture and live music thrive again?
items.description: The cost of alcohol is grinding Australia's old pub culture and live music venues into dust. Should we keep forging ahead with six-monthly increases in the beer excise?

items.title: Big falls ahead for some of Australia's major stocks as they reveal profits
items.description: Australia's largest companies will reveal how they performed financially over the next few weeks, against the gloomy backdrop of a property downturn, stubborn inflation, higher interest rates and the Iran war.

items.title: Grandmother torched own home after late husband left it to someone else
items.description: A grandmother, who burned down the home she'd lived in for decades after being left out of her late husband's will, has been handed a suspended jail sentence.

items.title: 'National tragedy': Experts warn of concerning NAPLAN knowledge gaps
items.description: NAPLAN test scores have revealed one-third of Australian students are not meeting "challenging but reasonable" expectations in literacy and numeracy.

items.title: 'Noose is tightening': One Nation's new Victorian leader promoted conspiracy
items.description: The new state One Nation leader warned of a debunked "globalist" plot to control Australians.

items.title: Mass funeral held in Gaza for 112 people killed in Israeli strike three years ago
items.description: The group being laid to rest were members of two extended families in Gaza, with some gathered for the event describing it as the largest funeral in the war-ravaged strip's history.

items.title: Police investigate arson on Victorian defence company as 'far-left terror'
items.description: It is the first time Australian authorities have investigated what they consider to be a potential far-left terror attack, motivated by anarchist and revolutionary ideology.

items.title: Five dead in Moscow region as Kyiv targets more Wildberries sites
items.description: Ukraine also targets another warehouse belonging to Russian e-commerce giant Wildberries as both sides trade strikes.

items.title: Labor was poised to reveal massive migration cuts, then suddenly delayed
items.description: The ABC understands the cuts to migration numbers are contentious within Labor, but no reason for the delay is given.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
